memoryRule: three distinct beats inside 1400ms classify a cadence; the tempo routes a remote echo, a real silence, and an afterbeat; the latest four events remain liftable
interactionRule: tap three distinct glyphs; the first two taps remain geometry-neutral; a valid third beat commits; Enter, Space, and play cadence use deterministic timing; Delete lifts latest; R or Escape releases
representationRupture: SVG route stations, DOM sentence refusal, and DOM word census -> p5.js Canvas 2D typographic score with three temporal columns and no connecting paths
encounterRupture: drag through stations, type letters, and wander across words -> compose a short three-beat cadence by tapping distinct glyphs
temporalRupture: spatial route memory, sentence-wide deletion, and latent attention -> interval-sensitive tempo memory that redirects a remote typographic rewrite
mediumRupture: inline SVG and semantic DOM typography -> p5.js Canvas 2D score with deterministic offscreen paper and ink layers
changedRule: Time, not path, selects the event: three distinct beats classify a tempo and spend it on three remote typographic roles while the tapped letters remain themselves.
visibleConsequence: The first view is a sparse three-column typographic score. A valid cadence leaves the tapped glyphs intact while a remote glyph echoes the source, another becomes an actual blank counterform, and a third shifts its baseline; later cadences inherit those changes.
falsifier: Delete if a single or duplicate beat changes geometry, if the tapped glyphs answer themselves, if tempo only changes metadata, if the blank is cosmetic, if later cadences forget, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v032 if caption-free viewing cannot show a temporal score with remote echo, silence, and afterbeat, or if the work reads as a type specimen with controls.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
